text:
incident-bot: [PAGER] 2167890123 HIGH fn_call error rate + API latency spike on inference-control plane. Auto-escalation to oncall. Affected: structured_output + function_call paths.

anna_oncall: acked. pulling up dashboards. seeing spikes in fn_call QPS to dedicated routing layer, error 503s from inference runtime.

chris_sre: do we have tenant scoping? looks like ~6 tenants producing 70% of fn_call traffic. suspect agent/assistant loops from a customer test harness.

elena_engineer: confirming. heatmap shows sudden increase starting 2167889000. KV cache thrashing and long GPU tail latencies. streaming queue backs up.

anna_oncall: priority: keep control plane healthy and avoid total outage. mitigation options: 1) tenant-level fn_call quarantine (disable function/tool calls for top offending tenants) 2) global soft-disable of structured_output for best-effort tier 3) throttle request-rate for fn_call routing.

chris_sre: I'll start tenant-level quarantine for top 6 offenders. preparing patch to feature-flag service. tagging with reason=fncall_surge.

elena_engineer: add immediate fallback policy to strip function_call from requests at edge for free/standard tiers. we can do header rewrite in api-gw to set X-Force-No-FnCall=true. code path is cheap and prevents downstream invocation.

anna_oncall: go for tenant quarantine first. post the commands you run. also inform support so they can craft customer messages.

chris_sre: executing now.
```bash
# quarantine top offenders
curl -X POST https://ops-internal.redwood/api/v1/flags/set \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"scope":"tenant","ids":["tenant-772","tenant-12b","tenant-980","tenant-3f1","tenant-55a","tenant-804"],"flag":"allow_function_calls","value":false,"meta":{"reason":"fncall_surge","ttl_seconds":3600}}'
```

deploy-bot: Feature flag change applied to 6 tenants (txn 0x8a3f). Rolling config to edge proxies.

anna_oncall: confirm effect on metrics.

elena_engineer: metrics: fn_call QPS down ~63% overall, inference runtime error rate dropping. tail latencies improving but still elevated for 20% of requests.

max_support: looping in CS and PGs. drafting message for affected tenants: "We detected elevated use of tool-calling that degraded inference performance. We temporarily disabled function/tool calling for your environment to protect service stability. We're monitoring and will restore in stages." want me to send now?

tia_prod: yes send now; include ETA window and ask for any high-priority workflows to contact support. please include link to status page.

max_support: sending to customers now.

customer-ops-bot: Customer messages queued: tenants 772,12b,980,3f1,55a,804. Template used: brief explanation + mitigation + contact path.

anna_oncall: next, global edge rewrite to strip function_call for free tier. elena, can you push a config to api-gw? keep it reversible.

elena_engineer: preparing nginx lua patch, will add header match on X-Tier:free and drop function_call payload element in-flight. patch looks like:
```lua
-- pseudo
if req:get_header("X-Tier") == "free" or req:get_header("X-Force-No-FnCall") == "true" then
  local body = ngx.req.get_body_data()
  -- naive strip: remove "function_call" field before proxy
  body = body:gsub('\"function_call\":%s*{.-},?', '"function_call": null')
  ngx.req.set_body_data(body)
end
```

elena_engineer: applying to canary pool (10% edge).

deploy-bot: Canary roll started (pool: edge-canary-1).

anna_oncall: monitor errors and user-visible regressions. if any major issues, abort.

chris_sre: while that's rolling, I'm also applying a temporary global soft-rate-limit for fn_call routing: 200 rps per region overall for non-enterprise tenants. policy applied via rate-service.

chris_sre: command:
```json
POST /api/rate-policy
{ "policy_name":"fncall_surge_mitigation","limit":200,"scope":"region","tenants":"non-enterprise","duration_seconds":300 }
```

deploy-bot: rate policy deployed to us-west and eu-west.

anna_oncall: status check: quarantine + rate limit + edge rewrite canary. metrics?

elena_engineer: comparing last 10m: total fn_call QPS -58%, runtime 5xx down from 3.2% to 0.9%, p95 latency from 420ms to 260ms. canary shows no customer-facing errors so far.

max_support: customer replies: 2 tenants asked for ETA for restoration (tenant-12b and tenant-55a). CS asks for guidance to offer temporary rate increases for critical workflows.

chris_sre: we can offer a controlled bypass via temporary whitelisting after manual review. require ticket to pg_and_sre and an emergency egress token.

anna_oncall: ok: make process explicit. CS, provide the ticket template and escalation path. ops should keep a short list of whitelisted request IDs.

max_support: acked. drafting template and will share.

customer-ops-bot: status page update prepared. short summary: "Mitigations in place to reduce impact while we stabilize function-calling traffic. Affected features: function/tool calling and structured outputs for some tenants and free tier. Next update in 30 minutes." Publish now?

anna_oncall: publish.

customer-ops-bot: status page updated (INC-2167890123).

chris_sre: note for post-incident: we need a protective guard in the model router to detect runaway agent loops and auto-rate-limit a tenant earlier. Also add synthetic probes to catch KV cache thrash patterns.

elena_engineer: logging task: tag all requests stripped of function_call so we can correlate user-reported regressions easily. add header X-Redwood-FunctionCall-Stripped:true.

deploy-bot: edge-canary rollout healthy, promoting to 50% pool.

anna_oncall: great. timeline and actions for next 60m: 1) monitor metrics and error pages 2) continue targeted quarantines if new offenders pop up 3) CS to field requests and vet whitelist tickets 4) plan incremental restore after 15m stable window.

chris_sre: will keep running list of quarantined tenants in #sre-runbook.

max_support: CS note: shared with customers and support teams. will escalate any high-priority business-impact cases to oncall immediately.

anna_oncall: if we hit regression after edge promotion, abort and rollback. otherwise we'll start staggered restores at 2167890900. keep this thread updated with any customer escalations.

customer-ops-bot: automated reminder: next status update scheduled in 30 minutes.

anna_oncall: closing initial mitigation window. thanks all.

chris_sre: follow-up: create post-incident ticket with root-cause markers and mitigation playbook entries. I'll own RCA.

elena_engineer: created issue: INF-4456 "fn_call surge: tenant quarantine playbook + gateway strip".

max_support: done. reaching out to affected tenants for any needed support.

anna_oncall: thread will remain open for live updates.
